name: The Road Less Travelled
source:
One October night in rural Philippines, the couple of Rose and June take a road trip that slides off course. A glitchy, haunted GPS pulls them onto a barren road. A fight boils over. The car crashes. As they lie there with too much left unsaid, time snaps back to the start. Again and again. And again and again and again and—

Take advantage of the second chance(s) granted to you in order to repair your relationship with your girlfriend while trying to avoid death. Paths branch through small choices, hard truths, and a car that seems to be judging your progress.

Can you work with your girlfriend to name the problem, own your part, and make a plan before the next turn? Or do you keep pulling at the thread until everything comes apart? In the end, one question lingers in the dead air:

Is this still worth fixing?

[From [url=https://delve-murder-nevermore.itch.io/the-road-less-travelled]itch.io[/url]]
